_README: Adjudication of the SEVEN open flags left by the 2026-08-10 std-PAT two-files sweep (runbook §73,
scripts/stdpat_adjud_verdicts.json 'open_flags'). NO ASSUMPTIONS, NO GUESSWORK: every verdict below
cites a primary document read this session — BSE detres (§42) with the FY quarter-sum identity (§45),
the filer's own NSE XBRL (classic corporates-financial-results and the 2025+ integrated-filing-results
endpoint), or the BSE announcement PDF read by COLUMN ANCHOR (§58).
Score: 5 flagged cells CONFIRMED CORRECT, 2 flagged cells DEFECTIVE, plus 2 companion defects found
en route — one of which is a heal the §73 campaign itself made in the WRONG direction.
THE LESSON (new sub-class of the §73 'wrong-year OneD' family): a value that is out of family is not
thereby wrong, and an identity that fails does not tell you WHICH cell failed it. Four of the five
flags were raised because a neighbour was wrong, not the flagged cell. Always close the FY chain with
every member independently sourced before naming the culprit.

METROPOLIS|20181231._no_mirror_why: METROPOLIS has NO sf_revop row for 20181231 (pre-IPO comparative quarter, never filed with an exchange, so build_revop has nothing to build from). Both revop files are derived, and verify_fills_live --repair only refills rows that already exist, so a stdpat_mirror_heals entry here would report MISSING forever. The value is pinned fund-side in pat_defects.json (watched on sf_fundamentals idx1).

BSE att 648d3237-5c5c-4438-8a1b-7d006d0c5cd6.pdf (Dec-2019 results, filed 06-Feb-2020), standalone page 4, row 7 'Profit for the period/year', column 3 = 'Quarter ended 31 December 2018': 2,280.23 lakh = 22.80. Column anchors on the same row: col2 'Quarter ended 30 September 2019' 3,167.72 == BSE detres Sep-19 316.77 Rs-mn EXACT; col6 'Year ended 31 March 2019 (Audited)' 10,145.70 == BSE detres FY19 .50 annual 1014.57 Rs-mn EXACT. Identities: 9M FY19 col5 6,196.05 = H1FY19 3,915.82 + 2,280.23 EXACT; FY19 = 6,196.05 + Q4 3,949.65 EXACT. EPS row col3 4.51 vs implied 2,280.23/501.785 lakh sh = 4.54 (stored 32.40 would imply 6.46). FY19 std chain after heal: 19.11+20.05+22.80+39.50 = 101.46 == 101.457.

RPSGVENT|20180630.src: RETRACTION of a §73 heal that read a double-indexed file's OneD as the target quarter. INDAS_48324_135139_04092019040116_WEB.xml is the JUN-2019 filing (ReportingQuarter 'First quarter', Symbol CESCVENT): OneD DateOfStartOfReportingPeriod 2019-04-01 / DateOfEnd 2019-06-30 = 2.15, FourD 2018-04-01..2018-06-30 = 1.65. NSE double-indexes that one file under BOTH the Jun-18 and Jun-19 list rows, so Jun-18 must take the FourD (year-ago) context = 1.65, and 2.15 belongs to Jun-2019 (where it is also stored, correctly). Identities with 1.65: 9M FY19 1.65+58.46+3.14 = 63.25 == the Dec-18 filing's own FourD (INDAS_42819 WEB, 2018-04-01..2018-12-31) EXACT; FY19 63.25+2.52 = 65.77 == Mar-19 filing FourD (INDAS_44334 WEB) AND BSE detres 542333 .50 audited annual 657.7 Rs-mn EXACT. EPS chain on 2.651e7 sh: Q1 0.62 (1.644), Q3 1.19 (3.155), Q4 0.95 (2.519), 9M 23.86, FY 24.81; implied Q2 EPS 23.86-0.62-1.19 = 22.05 -> 58.46 EXACT. Jun-2019 independently: Sep-19 filing INDAS_50741 H1FY20 FourD 76.77 - OneD Q2 74.62 = 2.15.

HALDER|20260331.src: H2-OWNERS-AS-QUARTER (same class as ABCOTS/RAJESHEXPO/CAPITALSFB in §73). The 29-May-2026 con filing INTEGRATED_FILING_INDAS_1676935 declares OneD 2025-10-01..2026-03-31 (H2, ReportingQuarter 'Yearly'): total 399,168,000 = 39.9168, owners 368,223,000 = 36.8223 <- the stored value, NCI 30,945,000. The CORRECTED 12-Jun-2026 filing INTEGRATED_FILING_INDAS_1681056 declares OneD 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 ('Fourth quarter', NameOfTheCompany 'Halder Venture Limited'): owners 161,854,000 = 16.1854, NCI 29,486,000, total 191,340,000; owners+NCI == total EXACT. Cross-checks: FY26 owners 2,873.84 lakh - 9M owners 1,255.30 lakh = 1,618.54; H2 owners 3,682.23 - Q3 owners 2,063.68 = 1,618.55. The 29-May PDF (BSE att 90a07d75-6664-49f5-99db-18c056d3430e.pdf p15) prints the Q4 column with NCI 294.86 lakh == the 12-Jun XBRL NCI 29,486,000 EXACT, confirming its first column IS the Jan-Mar quarter. (HALDER's printed EPS uses weighted-average shares against a paid-up capital that moved 115,973,000 -> 116,154,000 -> 124,381,000 within FY26, so EPS does not arbitrate here; the owners+NCI=total identity and the FY/9M/H2 chains do, and all close exactly.) Std side re-verified correct: 12-Jun std INDAS_1681055 OneD Jan-Mar 28,398,000 = 2.84 == stored.

Mar-2019 cluster CON announce dates.measured: GREAVESCOT's BSE archive holds NO filing of any category in September 2019, so 20190911 cannot be an announcement date. CARERATING's two Mar-2019 result filings are dated 05-21 and 05-22, so 20190525 matches neither. EMKAY's sole Mar-2019 result filing is 05-28, so 20190813 is its Jun-2019 date.
Mar-2019 cluster CON announce dates.why_not_healed: The flag, and the evidence gathered, are about the STANDALONE announce dates. Whether each of these boards also released the consolidated statement in the SAME filing is not established by the announcement metadata alone (GSFC's and CARERATING's NEWSSUB/headline say 'Standalone and Consolidated'; EMKAY's and GREAVESCOT's do not say). A con date is therefore UNKNOWN, not guessable — writing the std date into the con slot would be exactly the assumption this repo forbids. Left for a run that reads the filings themselves.
